title: ScanNet++ official toolkit
summary: The official ScanNet++ toolkit rasterizes scene meshes into DSLR or iPhone images, records pixel-to-face and z-buffer mappings, projects semantic and instance annotations, and computes object visibility and view coverage.

mechanisms.name: Mesh z-buffer visible-instance projection
mechanisms.description: Rasterize the authoritative mesh into the camera view and retain target pixels that survive z-buffer visibility and instance projection before reading depth or fitting geometry.
mechanisms.limitations: The toolkit provides projection and visibility machinery, not a door detector, cross-view identity proof, functional entrance label, arrival verifier, or BlindAssist result. Dataset access and label quality still bound any experiment.
